warning: Player examples are preserved exactly. Assistant refinements are tentative visual interpretations, not official or world-verified boundaries. A past or Abyssea raster inherits a shape only where it is listed here as inherited_from_present_day_raster, after its artwork was compared with the present-day map's.
principles: Follow the physical feature and its mapped route, not the label center.
Rivers and bridges need narrow bent corridors with meaningful endpoints.
Include surrounding terrain for broad geographical areas; keep ponds and fountains compact.
Refine beaches to their coast and access terrain rather than uniformly dilating polygons.
Use text leaders and terrain edges to relocate misplaced OCR-derived centers.
Keep explicit disabled examples disabled; their reason is not inferred.
The separate approach buffer is not baked into these polygons.
